title: roseSwords
description: reworks a netherite sword into a beautiful 3D model
body:
🌹 Rose's Netherite Sword — 3D Model Pack
A detailed 3D model replacement for the Netherite Sword, featuring a custom rose-themed design with smooth vanilla+ aesthetics.

⭐ Overview
Rose's Netherite Sword transforms the default Netherite Sword into a beautifully crafted 3D model inspired by roses. The pack keeps the original Minecraft atmosphere while adding elegant floral details to create a unique and immersive visual experience. Perfect for players who want to personalize their weapons without breaking the vanilla style.

🌹 Features
✨ Core Changes
Custom 3D Model – Full geometry overhaul with rose-themed elements

Vanilla+ Aesthetic – Blends perfectly with default Minecraft textures

Clean Silhouette – Easy to recognize in hotbar and during combat

🎨 Model Details
Blade – Reinforced Netherite structure with subtle engravings

Guard – Ornate rose-shaped crossguard with 3D petals

Handle – Wrapped grip with thorn details

Pommel – Rose bud finishing touch

🛠️ Display Positions
Optimized for all perspectives:

First-person

Third-person

Ground items

GUI inventory

📦 Compatibility
✅ Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11

✅ Works with Vanilla clients

✅ OptiFine not required (CIT not used)

✅ Works with any texture pack (load this pack above others)

📥 Installation
Download the .zip file (do not extract it)

Open Minecraft and go to Options → Resource Packs

Click "Open Pack Folder"

Move the downloaded .zip file into the folder

Find the pack in the list and click the arrow to move it to Selected

Click "Done" and enjoy your new sword! ✨
